# QuickOper

> Verified-calculation tools for personal money decisions. Every calculation runs
> entirely in the visitor's browser; no input is transmitted, logged or stored.

QuickOper computes, it does not advise. Each tool performs deterministic
arithmetic and publishes its formula, its intermediate values, a full
period-by-period schedule, and the fixture tests proving its output matches a
real published third-party figure.

Nothing on this site is financial, tax or investment advice. The expertise
claimed is computational, not advisory.

## Tools

### Debt payoff calculator — avalanche vs snowball
URL: https://quickoper.com/finance/debt-payoff-calculator
Computes: months to debt freedom and total interest, for the avalanche and
snowball strategies and for a minimum-payments-only baseline, with a full
month-by-month schedule.
Inputs: per-debt balance, annual rate and minimum payment; one total monthly
payment.
Jurisdiction: none. Interest is charged monthly on the opening balance, which
is a convention, not a rule of any one country.
Methodology: https://quickoper.com/methodology
Verification: https://quickoper.com/verify

### Coast FIRE calculator
URL: https://quickoper.com/finance/coast-fire-calculator
Computes: the amount that must already be invested for it to reach a retirement
target with no further contributions, plus a year-by-year projection.
Inputs: current age, retirement age, amount invested, annual spending,
withdrawal rate, real annual return, monthly contribution.
Jurisdiction: none. No tax treatment or account type is modelled.
Methodology: https://quickoper.com/methodology
Verification: https://quickoper.com/verify

## Verification

- [Methodology](https://quickoper.com/methodology): formulas, assumptions and the
  source of every test fixture.
- Source and tests: https://github.com/TheVikashSingh/quickoper
